The scanner drops list items before it scores anything, so the words in the
list below never reach the prose stream at all.

The failure showed up at its core-dump stage, where a phrase that only looks
like signposting sits inside a longer hyphenated word.

- Focal vocabulary on a wrapped item: delve, tapestry, pivotal,
  intricate, meticulously, multifaceted, seamless, testament.
- Another item that wraps onto
  a second line carrying holistic and cornerstone as well.
